description: This file contains unit tests for the encapsulation router endpoints, specifically testing the /encapsulation/pack, /encapsulation/tx/dequeue, and /encapsulation/rx/dequeue endpoints. It verifies correct behavior for encapsulating Ethernet frames into segments, dequeuing transmitted segments, and dequeuing received segments, including boundary cases and error handling.

classes.name: TestEncapsulationPack
classes.description: Test suite for /encapsulation/pack endpoint, verifying encapsulation behavior with various Ethernet frame sizes and parameters.

classes.name: TestTXDequeue
classes.description: Test suite for /encapsulation/tx/dequeue endpoint, verifying dequeueing of transmitted segments, including empty queue, normal operation, partial dequeue, and boundary cases.

classes.name: TestRXDequeue
classes.description: Test suite for /encapsulation/rx/dequeue endpoint, verifying dequeueing of received segments, including empty queue, after push, and invalid parameter handling.
